description: Module for looking up symbolic debugging information, including symbol names, offsets, and source locations. Contains functions for symbol resolution, demangling, and cache management.

classes.name: ProcessCache
classes.description: Manages cached subprocess pipes for symbolization tools, with LRU eviction and process cleanup.

methods.name: GetProcess
methods.description: Returns a cached subprocess pipe for a given command, creating a new one if necessary.

methods.name: SpawnProcess
methods.description: Creates a new subprocess pipe for a command.

methods.name: TerminateProcess
methods.description: Closes and terminates a subprocess pipe.
